title: PLACEMENT_MIN_SEP_TILES is game-balance data hard-coded in core instead of balance.json (ODN-5 deviation)
detail: The rationale is technically correct — catalogs_hash_sources folds src.balance into cat.hash (core/catalog.odin:506), so a field addition would shift every golden. Still, a tuned prototype balance value now lives in code, invisible to balance.json editors until the next re-bless.
recommended_fix: Keep the documented deferral; add a tracking note (or issue) so the const moves into balance.json at the next legitimate golden re-bless, per the comment's own ODN-5 migration plan.

title: Placement mode authority is duplicated: App.placing vs Drag_State.placing with manual sync at 5+ sites
evidence:
app.drag.placing = -1 // 3.5: not placing (a zero struct would read as type 0)
app.placing = -1
...
app.placing = -1
app.drag.active = false
app.drag.placing = -1
...
app.placing = (app.placing == tidx) ? -1 : tidx // click again to cancel
app.drag = {}
app.drag.placing = app.placing
...
app.drag.placing = app.placing
detail: The render keys its ghost branch on drag.placing (view.odin draw_world) while the input FSM keys on app.placing; every transition (start_run, ESC/right-click, tier chip, router chip, per-frame) manually re-syncs the pair. Correct today, but each future cancel/mode path must repeat the dance or the ghost silently desyncs.
recommended_fix: Make App.placing the single authority and derive drag.placing in one sync helper (e.g. set_placing(app, v)) called from every transition, so render and FSM can never drift.

title: Router_Ports_Full hint suggests "upgrade" — no upgrade command exists in the v2 command set
evidence: case .Router_Ports_Full: return "router ports full — demolish a pipe or upgrade"
detail: Command_Kind in core/types.odin carries only Cmd_Draw_Pipe, Cmd_Demolish_Pipe, Cmd_Demolish_Node, Cmd_Place_Router — upgrade is prototype-only (a later story). The error model's stated purpose is an actionable hint, but the second suggested remedy is not actionable in v2; a player at port capacity gets pointed at a nonexistent action.
recommended_fix: Trim the hint to "router ports full — demolish a pipe" until the upgrade story lands, then restore the reference.
